mechanism.claim: When both completed halves of the 00:00-08:00 UTC BTC session move in the same strict direction, the session represents sustained price discovery rather than a single late impulse. Follow that common direction through the remaining sixteen hours before the next UTC-day handoff.
mechanism.side: common strict sign of 00:00-04:00 and 04:00-08:00 completed returns
mechanism.why_distinct: ASCR uses intraday half-session concordance at 08:00 UTC. It is not completed-day decisive-close momentum, Monday/weekend handoff, 3d/14d trend concordance, run persistence, flow, funding, or a volatility threshold.
mechanism.volatile_market_target: two consecutive directional session halves should capture persistent displacement during volatile auctions; causal RV20 q90 is only a later audit
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: at most one conditional 08:05 UTC position per day with a fixed midnight handoff

features.first_window: exact 240 one-minute bars [00:00,04:00) UTC on decision day
features.second_window: exact 240 one-minute bars [04:00,08:00) UTC on decision day
features.concordance: first and second returns have the same sign
features.source_valid: exact unique minute grids, coherent finite positive OHLC, no imputation

rv20_stress_slice.rv20: sqrt(365*mean exact daily returns^2 over t-20 through t-1)
rv20_stress_slice.threshold: numpy linear q90 over 756 strictly prior available RV20 observations
rv20_stress_slice.future_use: only after all sequential full-calendar stages pass

clock.decision: daily 08:00 UTC after both session halves complete
clock.reservation: global half-open; exit first on equal open
clock.funding: not an input; exact realized funding only after novelty

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding, 6bp base and 10bp stress per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

post_stage_volatility_audit.prerequisite: unchanged candidate passes train, test, eval, final
post_stage_volatility_audit.persistent_long_vol_comparator: same accepted clock and 0.5 gross, side forced long
post_stage_volatility_audit.rv20_q90_decomposition: same decomposition on causal RV20 q90 decisions

definitions.full_session_return: strict sign of the completed 00:00-08:00 return without half-session concordance
definitions.first_half_only: strict sign of 00:00-04:00 return on every source-valid opportunity
definitions.second_half_only: strict sign of 04:00-08:00 return on every source-valid opportunity

source_plan.execution_prices: sealed until source support and Gross9 novelty pass

stopping_rule: terminal first failure; no session, concordance, side, clock, hold, RV20, subset, comparator, control, or gate repair
